description: Read the FIELDS a custom or Community Gallery template accepts, straight from the template's own source. Call this after templates_import_from_gallery and BEFORE tags_create, so the tag is built with that template's real parameter keys instead of guessed ones. Returns each field's name (the key for the tag's `parameter` array), its widget type, its label, whether it is required, and any fixed options. Also returns the template's tagType, so one call gives everything tags_create needs. Read-only. Only works for custom and gallery templates: GTM's ~68 BUILT-IN vendor templates carry no source, so for those use tags_type_profile against a container that already has one.
name: templates_describe_fields
